fn SwapFirstAndLast(a: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(a) > 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(a))
  ensures (result[0] == a[(len(a) - 1)])
  ensures (result[(len(result) - 1)] == a[0])
  ensures forall i in 1..(len(result) - 1): (result[i] == a[i])
  effects pure
  example (SwapFirstAndLast([]) == [])
